title: Strategy Memo – Week 5
author: John (GM)
modeWhy: 99% playoff odds and a 4-win cushion over 8th. Spend it building the Weeks 15-17 roster; bye hunt on the side.
huddle: Pulled in Sam (rumor mill, Sleeper trends), Tony (waiver competition), Frank (practice), Maya (odds). Grace shaped the briefing.

items: 4-0, #1 seed, 410.5 points for (2nd).
Playoffs 99%, #1 seed 56%, +4.0 wins over 8th place.
Bye rivals: Liddle' Schitty (3-1) and Oviedo (3-1). We play Oviedo Wk 10 and Liddle' Wk 13: full lineup both weeks (head-to-head is the first tiebreaker).
Bye crunch: Wk 6 (Washington, Jones), Wk 7 (Allen), Wk 11 (6 starters). Accept a Wk 11 loss rather than spend assets.
We are 14th of 14 in waiver order. Every free agent is on waivers, so every claim competes.
The market is on our targets: Meyers is fantasy's #2 add today (1.6M Sleeper adds), Shipley #5.
Claim order: 1) Meyers (unlikely), 2) Maye (unlikely), 3) Mixon (hold: claim only if Seattle confirms him).
Our real edge as the last pick: the free-agent sprint. When waivers clear, unclaimed players become instant adds. We act first, the moment they clear.
Allen's Wk 7 bye: QB from next week's waivers or the sprint, chosen for matchup.
We own both Seattle stashes: Charbonnet (ACL, activation ~Wk 7) and Price (IR, eligible Wk 8).
Rumor: Seattle planned a Mixon practice-squad deal pending a physical; one report says it fell through.
Rumor: Seattle linked to a Tony Pollard trade. Liddle' (bye rival) owns Pollard.
Seattle is shopping for backs, which caps our stashes' upside. Options: own the incoming back, or sell a stash before the market reacts. Decision once Mixon's status is confirmed.
Shop Aaron Jones now: bell-cow only while Jordan Mason is on IR. Mason eligible Wk 7; Jones on bye Wk 6.
Shop Brian Robinson: 3 TDs Monday night, value at its peak.
Target Rashid Shaheed (Team RM): returner + deep threat, both bonus points for us. RM is RB-starved.
Offer: Jones + Robinson for Shaheed. Fallback: Jones alone.
Buy-low watch: A.J. Brown (back Wk 7-8), Justin Jefferson (JV Squad 1-3).
Josh Jacobs: suspension risk. Cut if it covers Wks 15-17.
Tyreek Hill: Chiefs reached out (Oct 5). Oviedo owns him; a KC deal strengthens a bye rival and hits Rashee Rice and Xavier Worthy values.
Ja'Marr Chase concussion timeline drives Meyers' value.
Saquon Barkley back in 1-3 weeks ends any Shipley rental.
Flip to WIN NOW if the cushion over 8th falls to 2 wins.
Hired Sam, Director of News Intelligence: source map across insiders, X, beat reporters and outlets; runs the rumor mill.
Tony: RETRAIN, done. Waiver competition and claim odds on every claim.
Frank: refocused on injuries, practice reports and league intel; Sam owns news sourcing.
Maya: KEEP. Grace: KEEP. Bill: KEEP.
ESPN fantasy API (league 293318), ESPN/Rotowire player news through Oct 6.
Confidence: high on facts and moves, medium on odds and claim outcomes.
